method: Product-area and feature-specific Fortinet Community searches were run for all 12 mandatory targets. Search results were screened for publication/update recency, failure-mode novelty, and relevance to the selected primary feature. Community material is scenario-only and never used as a primary lesson source.

queries: FortiGate BGP VPNv4/VPNv6 next-hop-self route-reflector troubleshooting
results.use: Mechanism-specific historical scenario: legacy next-hop-self-rr did not rewrite VPNv4 next hop; used only as an older failure illustration.

queries: FortiManager FortiSASE multitenancy FortiManager Key ADOM
results.use: Community category sweep returned recent FDS/FGFM/ADOM/agentless-ZTNA items, but none directly exposed FortiSASE multi-instance OU/key/ADOM behavior.

queries: FortiAnalyzer SAML SHA-256 SHA-512 signature digest
results.use: Older adjacent SAML scenario focused on RelayState/ACS rather than SHA-256/SHA-512 negotiation; used to teach diagnostic separation.

queries: FortiSwitchOS BGP local-AS multiple autonomous systems
results.use: No FortiSwitch-specific community scenario for the 8.0 per-neighbor local-AS enhancement was verified.
No directly matching FortiAP Community MLO failure scenario was verified.
Direct scenario: FortiNAC-OS servers could not be added/synchronized when Manager and managed-server allowed serial lists were incorrect; supports the lesson's role-specific allowlist diagnosis.

queries: FortiNAC-F FortiGate VDOM multi-tenancy shared FortiLink
results.use: No directly matching VDOM port-export/tenant VLAN/host-placement Community scenario was verified.

queries: FortiAuthenticator 8.0.2 RADIUS client groups Authentication Profiles
results.use: Search results contained other RADIUS and cryptography tips, but no direct client-group/policy-profile selection failure scenario.

queries: FortiPAM 1.9 launcher process matcher window-title command-line
results.use: No directly matching process-matcher Community scenario was verified.

queries: FortiSIEM 7.5.1 Python threat feed import SSL Verify
results.use: Community results included older FortiGuard IOC validation guidance, but no direct Python plugin/CSV ingestion failure scenario.

queries: FortiSASE software-change vulnerability scan endpoint profile
results.use: No directly matching software-change/PUA-triggered scan scenario was verified.
No directly matching ToS-mask duplication/de-duplication Community scenario was verified.

limitations: Search indexing exposed some older or adjacent Community articles; these were not mislabeled as recent or as primary feature documentation.

A direct recent Community scenario was verified for FortiNAC only. Other selected lessons remain grounded in official product documentation and are explicitly marked as lacking a direct scenario match.
